d: Brazil’s presidential run-off has ended with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeating Flavio Bolsonaro, son of jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro. Despite trailing in the first round, Lula secured a majority, setting historic records and becoming Brazil’s oldest president. Bolsonaro Jr. has alleged the election was rigged and refused to concede, while claims of political influence and social media bias have added to the controversy.
